metadata.description: Coursera Downloader master plan. Source of truth; TASKS.md is generated from this.
metadata.goal: Reliable local download manager (FastAPI + plain HTML/JS, Windows, 127.0.0.1 only) for Coursera material the user's own account is enrolled in.
non_goals: No bypassing Coursera auth, enrollment, paywalls or DRM
No credential storage or username/password login
No cloud, hosting, multi-user or remote access
No paid APIs, CDNs, analytics or telemetry
No front-end framework or build step, no Celery/Redis/queues, no ORM
No Electron/Tauri/Qt, scheduling, notifications, themes, pause
No Chrome support in v1; only Windows is verified
